title: Angry Duck
description: Preheat, propagation, rescue, mirror and image cleanup for Angry Duck 1.8.4.

panels.title: Workers reporting
panels.description: Nodes with an Angry Duck worker exposing metrics.

panels.title: Images stuck
panels.description: Node/image pairs currently in ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull, as seen by the rescuer.

panels.title: Active propagations
panels.description: Pushed images currently being spread across the fleet.

panels.title: Nodes cleaning
panels.description: Nodes whose disk is above GC_HIGH_UTILIZATION and not yet back to GC_LOW_UTILIZATION.

panels.title: Mirror hit ratio (1h)
panels.description: Share of containerd's mirror requests served inside the cluster (local or peer) over the last hour.

panels.title: Registry bytes avoided (24h)
panels.description: Bytes delivered from inside the cluster instead of the registry: mirror hits plus peer transfers received.

panels.title: Seed pull orders by result
panels.description: Pull orders the controller sent to seed workers.

panels.title: Seed pull orders by node
panels.description: Which nodes are being chosen as seeds.

panels.title: Seed pulls by result
panels.description: Registry pulls executed by seed workers.

panels.title: Average seed pull duration
panels.description: Seconds per successful registry pull, per node.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_pull_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result='success'}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result='success'}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Seed ranking basis
panels.description: How seeds were ranked: layers (bytes already held) or a fallback (repo, utilization). Fallbacks usually mean a manifest couldn't be read.

panels.title: Registry download per seed (latest image)
panels.description: Bytes of the latest seeded image each seed lacked, i.e. what it had to fetch from the registry.

panels.title: Seed pulls in flight / timeouts
panels.description: Registry pulls running now, and slow seeds cancelled in favor of peers.

panels.title: Nodes per state (all images)
panels.description: Across all images being spread: nodes that have it, are missing it, are receiving it, are still seeding, or were skipped.

panels.title: Propagation progress per image
panels.description: Current state of every image being spread.

panels.title: Transfers by result
panels.description: Peer-to-peer transfers ordered by the propagator.

panels.title: Transfers by receiving node
panels.description: Which nodes received propagated images.

panels.title: Finished propagations
panels.description: complete: every eligible node has it. superseded: a newer tag was pushed. expired: PROPAGATE_WINDOW_S ran out.

panels.title: Stuck images per node
panels.description: Images each node can't pull right now.

panels.title: Rescue decisions
panels.description: success / failure, or why no attempt was made: no_source (no node has the image), no_target, pull_policy_always.

panels.title: Failing rescues
panels.description: Node and image pairs with failed rescue attempts in a row.

panels.title: Transfers received by reason and result
panels.description: Images workers fetched from peers, for a stuck pod (rescue) or after a push (propagate).

panels.title: Rescues in flight
panels.description: Rescues running now (controller view).

panels.title: Transfer throughput
panels.description: Bytes moved between nodes (blobs and compressed snapshots) for rescue and propagation.

panels.title: Layers by delivery method
panels.description: present: already unpacked here. blob: verified compressed layer. snapshot: shipped directory (last resort).

panels.title: Snapshot share of shipped layers
panels.description: Share of shipped layers that had to go as snapshots. High values usually mean discard_unpacked_layers = true.

panels.title: Top senders
panels.description: Nodes serving the most bytes to peers.

panels.title: Pinned snapshots and leftover cleanups
panels.description: Snapshots kept for a retry, and leftovers removed (temp_snapshot, temp_image, expired_pin).

panels.title: Mirror requests by result
panels.description: local: from this node. peer: streamed from another node. miss: containerd went to the registry.

panels.title: Mirror hit ratio
panels.description: Share of mirror requests served inside the cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~'local|peer'}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kind) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mirror bytes served
panels.description: Bytes the mirror delivered to containerd, by source. Every byte is one not downloaded from the registry.

panels.title: Disk-pressure cleanup per node
panels.description: Orange while a node is above GC_HIGH_UTILIZATION and not yet back to GC_LOW_UTILIZATION.

panels.title: Images removed by tier
panels.description: old: unused past GC_UNUSED_FOR_S. pressure: removed early because the disk was above high. rollback: one of the newest per repo, removed as a last resort.

panels.title: Removal candidates by tier
panels.description: Images that could be removed right now. pressure and rollback candidates are only removed while a node is cleaning.

panels.title: Images removed per node
panels.description: Which nodes are removing the most images.

panels.title: Running containers from preheated repos
panels.description: Running containers whose repo was preheated on that node recently: a rough signal that preheat lands where pods run.

panels.title: Layer index size
panels.description: Distinct blob digests and snapshot chainIDs tracked by the controller across all nodes.
